about: reelkit.fx: env_ad, FlashBudget, Shake, Flares, the envelopes of Moments and Marks.live

args.what: the bright bursts of the example episode
ties: priority, then the order given; an event exactly one window later
times that are equal once rounded to 4 places are taken by priority: the later, stronger one wins
the frames after each jolt of the example episode
at each jolt itself, at the end of its look-back and just before it
one point, as np.atleast_2d makes it

note: Row-wise calls: one Python call per row of the input arrays. Shake(...).offset(t): out is (n, 2). Flares(...).at(t): per time of "t", "count" lights; their positions "p", colours "c" and radii "r" follow one another. tint: "P" (k, 3) points, out (k, 3). apply: the points of a fresh Lights after FL.apply(L, t), as at. Moments(...).active(t): per time, "count" rows of "which" (the index of the add call in the script), "e" and "u"; dim_k and env one value per row. Marks(...).live(t): per time, "count" rows of "which", "k" and "age".
